$comment: Content pillars, hashtags and tone for the weekly generator (.claude/skills/marketing-weekly). Edit freely; the generator reads this every week.

slots.timezone: Asia/Bangkok (UTC+7; Vietnam is the same offset)
slots.note: Baseline from published posting-time studies for VN/TH. After two weeks, move slots toward the hours Threads/Instagram insights show.

rules: Short sentences, sentence case, never ALL CAPS (tone marks break, Thai has no case).
Sound like a friend showing an app, not a brand announcing one. No superlatives ('best', 'perfect').
Only claim what the app does today (free, no ads, no account, data stays on the device, 70 frames, 100 stickers, 8 shots pick 4, countdown).
Say iPhone/iPad or App Store once per post or in the bio: 60-67% of readers are on Android.
Reuse vocabulary from design/i18n/{common,nuni,fourpop}/{vi,th}.json and docs/release/store-*.md so the app and the posts speak the same words.
Threads: ask a question or invite a reply (replies drive reach). Instagram/TikTok: 'link in bio' instead of a URL.
One emoji at most. No prices, no countdown-to-launch hype, no fake user quotes.
tone.vi: Thân thiện, hơi vui, dùng 'bạn'. Từ khóa văn hóa: sống ảo, chữa lành, bạn thân, hội bạn.
tone.th: เป็นกันเอง สบาย ๆ ใช้ 'คุณ' หรือไม่ใส่สรรพนาม คำวัฒนธรรม: ฮีลใจ, เพื่อนสนิท, ถ่ายรูปเล่น

iosLine.th: มีบน iPhone และ iPad

linkInBio.th: ลิงก์ในไบโอ

hashtags.note: 3-5 tags per post. Rotate; add one trend tag only when it is genuinely relevant.

fourpop.title: Pose ideas
fourpop.brief: One strip, four poses with a theme (bff, couple, solo, silly). Caption names the theme and asks which pose they'd try.

fourpop.title: Frame of the day
fourpop.brief: One frame from the manifest, its vibe in one line, where it fits (date, trip, exam week). Rotate packs: base, pop, y2k, studio, season.

fourpop.title: Season pack
fourpop.brief: Only while a pack is live (marketing/seasons.json). Show 2-4 frames of the pack.

fourpop.title: Booth at home
fourpop.brief: Tiny tutorial: prop the phone, countdown, 8 shots, pick 4, add stickers, save. One step per post.

fourpop.title: Four-cut culture
fourpop.brief: Korean photo booth culture (why 4 cuts, the date stamp, the black studio frame). Educational, no brand names.

fourpop.title: Join a trend
fourpop.brief: Only when a real TikTok/Threads trend fits; otherwise skip this pillar for the week.

nuni.title: Today's cloud
nuni.brief: Ask which of the five clouds today is (rain, low, okay, good, great). Threads text post; replies are the point.

nuni.title: Mascot mood
nuni.brief: Relatable Gen Z moment with the cloud mascot at the matching mood (exam week, Monday, payday).

nuni.title: What lifts you
nuni.brief: How the month view and tags show what actually lifts your mood. Feature-true, no medical claims.

nuni.title: One healing line
nuni.brief: A short, warm sentence (chữa lành / ฮีลใจ). No toxic positivity, no advice.

nuni.title: Gentle streak
nuni.brief: Celebrate 7/30-day streaks as 'you showed up', never guilt.

nuni.title: Lucky colour (TH only)
nuni.brief: Thai colour-of-the-day culture meets the five mood colours. Light, playful.

photoQueries.note: Pexels search terms for strip photos. Prefer candid, natural light, friends; avoid studio stock looks. Southeast Asian faces when available.
candid: young man smiling portrait natural light
